scope: Permits audited exact representation transforms for source-authorized T0 formulas; it does not permit construct proxies or outcome-derived fields.
authority: The frozen v4 gate allows data that are already present or can be stably derived from audited T0 inputs. This amendment makes the evidence test explicit.
admissibility_rules: The literature formula and target quantity must be identical, including numerator, denominator, unit and time boundary.
A deterministic, outcome-blind derivation from allowed local T0 inputs must reproduce a trusted stored representation with exact numeric equality over the audited overlap.
The derivation transform, input hashes, overlap size, equality rate, coverage and missing rule must be recorded.
Rows outside audited coverage remain missing; they are never silently treated as zero.
A field that is merely correlated with, adjacent to, or a different metadata representation of the source construct remains prohibited.
initially_eligible_quantities: author_count = expm1(log_author_count), subject to the operational-equivalence audit
reference_count = expm1(log_reference_count), subject to the operational-equivalence audit
explicitly_not_authorized: metadata fields as a proxy for data-availability statements
precomputed page/title/peer-review variables without source-matched coding and missing rules
future citations, future attention, future disruption or post-T0 indexing
required_next_step: Independent AI/H1 evidence is retained; H2 must re-adjudicate only affected candidates against the completed operational_equivalence_audit_v4.json.
